facts.function: blade/target that lets a sensor detect crankshaft position
facts.end_use: spark ignition internal combustion piston engines

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8409 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with engines of heading 8407 or 8408
Section XVI note 2(b): a part suitable solely or principally for one kind of machine goes with that machine's parts heading; not a part of general use (Section XV note 2) as it is engine-specific
GRI 6: 8409.91 spark-ignition engines, 8409.91.99 Other, 90 Other (not connecting rods)

rejected_alternatives.reason: N270502 put a generic iron crankshaft sensor wheel there (car, not specific to engine type); here the blade is stated to be for spark ignition piston engines, so heading 8409 applies
sensor itself (HQ 967135) is an electrical device; a passive blade is not
does not transmit torque, per N270502

missing_facts: material and whether it is a passive target or contains electronics
whether it is principally used with spark-ignition engines only
classification.rationale: A crankshaft sensing blade described as used in spark-ignition piston engines is a part solely or principally used with those engines under heading 8409, subheading 8409.91. N270502 is in force but covers a sensor wheel of a motor vehicle placed in 7326, showing the alternative; the engine-specific description favors 8409.91.
